programme.title: Strange Evidence
programme.desc: S2 E5 — Return of the Ice MonsterA father and his children are being filmed as a bolt of lightning mysteriously strikes at them from a clear blue sky. Scientists try to work out why a football stadium dome, thought to be indestructible, catastrophically collapses. A giant ice creature is spotted in Alaska, while a jet has a close encounter with a UFO.

programme.title: Discovered by Disaster
programme.desc: S1 E7 — Ancient Cities and Enduring CreaturesUnexpected things revealed by catastrophic disasters, featuring a submerged funerary complex in Greece, ancient mammal footprints preserved by a Turkish volcanic eruption and North American fossils from the post-dinosaur era.

programme.title: Walking Through History
programme.desc: S3 E3 — North NorfolkTony Robinson travels along the north Norfolk coast through one of the least developed spots in Britain, finding out how the area maintained its rural, remote identity despite the dynamic industrial changes of the Victorian age. From the arrival of Bertie, Prince of Wales at Sandringham House to the opening of Cromer Pier, Tony's four-day walk sees him learn about key periods in the county's history. He explores prime shooting estates, purpose-built seaside resorts, salt marshes and disused railway lines as he discovers how powerful landowners were able to control development and even shape the railways to suit their needs.

programme.title: Walking Through History
programme.desc: S4 E1 — Brontë CountryTony Robinson embarks on another expedition through some of Britain's most historic landscapes. The moors and valleys of West Yorkshire were the home of, and inspiration for, the Brontës, the literary family who produced such classics as Wuthering Heights and Jane Eyre. Over four days, Tony heads out from the Victorian wool capital of Bradford and treks in a giant loop around what is now known as Brontë Country. From the birth of Charlotte, Emily, Anne and their brother Branwell in the suburb of Thornton, he traces their childhoods to the much-romanticised Brontë hub of Haworth, finding that the harsh reality of life in the 1820s was far removed from the fantasy world dreamed up by the children at their father's parsonage home.

programme.title: Dickinson's Real Deal
programme.desc: S9 E16 — Stoke 3David Dickinson is in Stoke-on-Trent, where dealers Michael Hogben, Brenda Haller and David Tupman inspect an Asprey silver chamberstick, a 1950s Wilson pram and a quirky game die with a view to making a possible purchase. Plus, antiques expert Simon Schneider tries to buy a pair of spelter warriors.

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: S22 E18 — Knock Your Sox OffCorey plays ball when he gets a signed letter that knocks his White Sox off. Next, Rick looks at a John Wilkes Booth poster that few would wish to hang in their bedrooms.

programme.desc: S4 E25 — Gardner Museum RobberyIn a perfectly planned robbery, thieves stole half a billion dollars in masterpieces from the Gardner Museum in Boston. The Isabella Stewart Gardner Museum Heist is easily the biggest art theft in history. It occurred on March 18, 1990, when two bogus police officers broke into the museum and took 13 works worth $500million. Three decades after the brazen heist, an exhaustive search has failed to recover the stolen goods.

programme.title: Aliens Vs Predator - Requiem
programme.desc: A spaceship crash results in the infestation of a small town by aliens, so a Predator is despatched to hunt them down - and any superfluous humans who happen to get in the way. However, an even bigger threat is lurking in the area, in the form of a terrifying hybrid of the two extraterrestrial creatures. Sci-fi action sequel, starring Steven Pasquale, Reiko Aylesworth and John Ortiz.

programme.title: I Love You, Beth Cooper
programme.desc: A teenager uses a graduation speech to publicly reveal a few secrets - including proclaiming his love for a pretty classmate. To his surprise, she is flattered by the gesture, but her ex-boyfriend is furious and they are soon forced to spend a night fleeing for their lives together. Comedy, starring Paul Rust and Hayden Panettiere.

programme.title: Bambi
programme.desc: A young deer grows up in the forest, forming close friendships with other woodland creatures. When tragedy strikes, he is suddenly forced to fend for himself but ultimately becomes brave and resourceful enough to save his friends during a forest fire. Animated drama, with the voices of Bobby Stewart, Hardie Albright and Donnie Dunagan.

programme.title: DuckTales the Movie: Treasure of the Lost Lamp
programme.desc: Scrooge McDuck and great-nephews Huey, Dewey and Louie lead an archaeological expedition to find a long-lost genie's lamp once belonging to a notorious bandit, but reckon without a villainous attempt to use its powers in a dastardly plot. Animated adventure, with the voices of Christopher Lloyd, Alan Young and Russi Taylor.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
programme.desc: Four children are evacuated from London during the Second World War and sent to a rural manor house where they discover a secret entrance to the mystical world of Narnia. There they help vanquish the wicked White Witch, whose curse has gripped the land in perpetual winter. Fantasy adventure based on the book by CS Lewis, with Tilda Swinton, Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, Anna Popplewell, William Moseley, James McAvoy and Jim Broadbent, and featuring the voice of Liam Neeson.

programme.title: Pocahontas
programme.desc: A Native American princess falls in love with an English settler, but her father is distrustful of the Europeans - not without just cause, as a cruel governor is prepared to wage war to get his hands on the gold he believes they are hiding. Animated drama, with the voices of Irene Bedard, Mel Gibson and Christian Bale.

programme.title: Frozen
programme.desc: A princess with the power to freeze anything she touches loses control of her abilities and plunges the kingdom into a perpetual winter. She goes into hiding, but her sister remains determined that she can be saved from her own magic and sets off on a quest to find her, aided by a mountain man and a living snowman. Disney animated fantasy adventure, with the voices of Kristen Bell and Idina Menzel.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast
programme.desc: A prince is transformed into a hideous monster as punishment for his selfishness, and can only regain his human form by finding true love. Salvation comes in the form of a spirited village girl, who offers to take her father's place when he is imprisoned in the monster's castle. But as romance blossoms between the unlikely pair, a jealous rival suitor only sees a beast to be slain. Live-action remake of the Disney animated fairy tale, starring Emma Watson, Dan Stevens and Luke Evans, with Ewan McGregor, Emma Thompson and Ian McKellen playing the Beast's entourage of living ornaments.

programme.title: A Goofy Movie
programme.desc: The Disney cartoon dog takes his son on an old-fashioned fishing trip in an attempt to bond with the lad. However, young Max has boasted to his pals that he is going to a pop concert in Los Angeles, and has a few ideas on how to trick his dopey dad. Animated comedy, featuring the voices of Bill Farmer, Jason Marsden and Wallace Shawn.

programme.title: Big Hero 6
programme.desc: A lonely, orphaned computer genius forms a special bond with an inflatable robot. When a devastating event occurs in their futuristic home city, they join forces with a group of friends to form a hi-tech band of heroes who are determined to get to the bottom of the matter. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Ryan Potter, Scott Adsit and Daniel Henney.

programme.title: Hercules
programme.desc: The son of Zeus, king of the Greek gods, is sent to Earth to be raised as a human. When he learns of his immortal heritage, he discovers he can only reclaim his position among the gods by becoming a true hero, so he embarks on a series of adventures and battles fearsome monsters to prove his worth. Disney animated adventure, with the voices of Tate Donovan, Danny DeVito, James Woods and Rip Torn.

programme.title: Inspector Gadget
programme.desc: A clumsy security guard is critically injured during a run-in with a thief, so his cybernetics-expert employer transforms him into the ultimate crime-fighting machine - a bionic officer with an array of gadgets and weaponry cunningly concealed inside his body. Comedy adventure based on the 1980s cartoon series, starring Matthew Broderick, Rupert Everett and Joely Fisher.

programme.title: Joy
programme.desc: An imaginative youngster with dreams of being an inventor grows up to be a downtrodden single mother, struggling to support her chaotic family. She sees a chance to turn all their lives around when inspiration strikes and she creates a new household tool, but faces the challenge of selling her product in the demanding world of a home shopping TV station. Fact-based drama, starring Jennifer Lawrence, Robert De Niro and Bradley Cooper.

programme.title: Gifted
programme.desc: Single man Frank Adler attempts to raise his child prodigy niece, Mary. However, his plans for a normal school life for the youngster are foiled when the youngster's mathematical abilities come to the attention of Frank's formidable mother, Evelyn. Drama, starring Chris Evans, Lindsay Duncan and Mckenna Grace.

programme.title: 28 Weeks Later
programme.desc: The US military oversees the repopulation of Britain after a virus that turned those infected into bloodthirsty killers finally dies out. Two children sneak away from a London safe zone and make a discovery that threatens to unleash the virus again. Juan Carlos Fresnadillo's horror sequel to 28 Days Later, with Robert Carlyle, Rose Byrne, Jeremy Renner, Imogen Poots and Idris Elba.

programme.title: The East
programme.desc: A former FBI agent working for a private security firm is sent to infiltrate an anarchist movement behind a series of actions against corrupt corporations. She joins them in their acts of sabotage, but finds her loyalties changing as she forms connections with members of the group. Thriller, starring Brit Marling, Elliot Page and Alexander Skarsgard.

programme.title: Flubber
programme.desc: A scatty professor is in financial trouble, and his only hope of avoiding disaster is to market his latest invention - a strange rubbery substance with a life of its own. However, a criminal gang is determined to get hold of his creation. Remake of 1961 Disney comedy The Absent-Minded Professor, with Robin Williams, Marcia Gay Harden, Christopher McDonald and Wil Wheaton.

programme.title: Bambi
programme.desc: A young deer grows up in the forest, forming close friendships with other woodland creatures. When tragedy strikes, he is suddenly forced to fend for himself but ultimately becomes brave and resourceful enough to save his friends during a forest fire. Animated drama, with the voices of Bobby Stewart, Hardie Albright and Donnie Dunagan.

programme.title: Mulan
programme.desc: A girl poses as a man so she can take her ailing father's place in the army and join in the battle against invading forces - a move that ensures her fame as a national hero. Disney animated adventure based on a Chinese folk tale, featuring the voices of Ming-Na, Eddie Murphy, BD Wong and Miguel Ferrer.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
programme.desc: Four children are evacuated from London during the Second World War and sent to a rural manor house where they discover a secret entrance to the mystical world of Narnia. There they help vanquish the wicked White Witch, whose curse has gripped the land in perpetual winter. Fantasy adventure based on the book by CS Lewis, with Tilda Swinton, Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, Anna Popplewell, William Moseley, James McAvoy and Jim Broadbent, and featuring the voice of Liam Neeson.

programme.title: Hercules
programme.desc: The son of Zeus, king of the Greek gods, is sent to Earth to be raised as a human. When he learns of his immortal heritage, he discovers he can only reclaim his position among the gods by becoming a true hero, so he embarks on a series of adventures and battles fearsome monsters to prove his worth. Disney animated adventure, with the voices of Tate Donovan, Danny DeVito, James Woods and Rip Torn.

programme.title: A Bug's Life
programme.desc: Well-meaning ant Flick lands his colony in trouble when he accidentally disposes of an offering meant for a swarm of greedy grasshoppers - who promptly promise a horrible revenge. Faced with the imminent destruction of the anthill, he sets out to save the situation by enlisting the help of a few would-be heroes - an out-of-work troupe of bugs from a low-rent flea circus. Pixar animation, with the voices of Dave Foley, Kevin Spacey and Julia Louis-Dreyfus.

programme.title: Aladdin
programme.desc: A street urchin is caught up in a scheming grand vizier's plot to get his clutches on a magical lamp. Retrieving the object from a wondrous cave, he releases a powerful genie trapped inside, whose ability to grant wishes helps the young hero thwart the villain's plans and woo a princess. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Robin Williams, Scott Weinger and Linda Larkin.

programme.title: Frozen
programme.desc: A princess with the power to freeze anything she touches loses control of her abilities and plunges the kingdom into a perpetual winter. She goes into hiding, but her sister remains determined that she can be saved from her own magic and sets off on a quest to find her, aided by a mountain man and a living snowman. Disney animated fantasy adventure, with the voices of Kristen Bell and Idina Menzel.

programme.title: Monsters, Inc
programme.desc: Two monsters work for an energy firm that employs scary creatures to sneak into children's bedrooms and convert their screams into power. However, when a little girl accidentally wanders into the pair's domain, they have to race against time to return her safely home before anyone finds out. Animated comedy, with the voices of John Goodman, Billy Crystal, Steve Buscemi and James Coburn.

programme.title: Percy Jackson: Sea of Monsters
programme.desc: The modern-day teenage son of the Greek god Poseidon must lead his friends on a perilous journey into the Bermuda triangle. They need to recover the legendary Golden Fleece to save the world, but getting to it means braving all manner of terrifying monsters. Fantasy adventure sequel, starring Logan Lerman and Alexandra Daddario.

programme.title: Ant-Man
programme.desc: A thief attempting to go straight is recruited by a scientist who provides him with a suit that gives him the power to shrink. He must use his new skills to carry out a special mission - helping the inventor to steal back his miniaturisation technology from a ruthless businessman who intends to turn it into a deadly weapon. Superhero adventure, starring Paul Rudd, Michael Douglas and Evangeline Lilly.

programme.title: Bad Company
programme.desc: A secret agent is murdered, leaving his veteran CIA partner to transform the dead man's streetwise twin from an uncouth hustler into a credible replacement for his brother, so the agency can continue its investigation into a diabolical terrorist plot involving a nuclear bomb. Comedy thriller, starring Anthony Hopkins, Chris Rock, Peter Stormare, Gabriel Macht and John Slattery.

programme.title: A Real Pain
programme.desc: Mismatched cousins David and Benji reunite for a tour through Poland to honour their beloved grandmother. Comedy drama, starring an Oscar and Bafta-winning Kieran Culkin, and Jesse Eisenberg, who also directed and won a Bafta for Best Original Screenplay.

programme.title: Nightbitch
programme.desc: A nameless stay-at-home Mother tends to her young son in the suburbs while Husband casually goes out to work. Trapped in a whirlpool of rage and frustration about the loss of her identity, Mother becomes convinced that she is turning into one of the dogs that roam the neighbourhood. Dark comedy adapted from Rachel Yoder's novel, starring Amy Adams and Scoot McNairy.

programme.title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: Dog Days
programme.desc: Weedy youngster Greg finds his plans for a lazy school holiday ruined when his mother bans video games and his father organises a series of family activities. When he finds out a girl he likes is working at a country club, he tells his family he has a summer job there as an excuse to spend time with her - but struggles to keep up the deception. Family comedy sequel, starring Zachary Gordon and Steve Zahn.

programme.title: DuckTales the Movie: Treasure of the Lost Lamp
programme.desc: Scrooge McDuck and great-nephews Huey, Dewey and Louie lead an archaeological expedition to find a long-lost genie's lamp once belonging to a notorious bandit, but reckon without a villainous attempt to use its powers in a dastardly plot. Animated adventure, with the voices of Christopher Lloyd, Alan Young and Russi Taylor.

programme.title: The Parent Trap
programme.desc: Identical twin sisters who are unaware of each other's existence meet by accident. They decide to join forces in a bid to reunite their estranged parents, and switch places to get the warring couple to kiss and make up. Remake of the 1961 Disney comedy, starring Dennis Quaid, Natasha Richardson, Elaine Hendrix and Lindsay Lohan in a dual role.

programme.title: Cars 2

programme.title: Jamie's Easy Meals for Every Day

programme.desc: S8 E4 — Tale of 2 SoupsWhen her friend Frank tells her he has some friends coming over, Ina sees an opportunity to test some of her favourite soups. Frank's guests are treated to two one-pot wonders: lentil sausage soup and seafood stew.

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: S2 E7 — PatisserieIt's semi-final time and the four remaining bakers must prove they are worth a place in the final. The signature challenge requires them to make a baked, layered, mousse cake. The technical challenge is Paul's favourite sweet treat - iced fingers. Finally, the bakers must produce a batch of three different types of pastries or croissants.

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: S2 E8 — The FinalMel Giedroyc and Sue Perkins host the grand final where Holly, Jo and Mary-Anne face their biggest challenge yet - baking for "The Great British Bake Off" street party. None of them have baked on this scale before. Amongst their offerings are mille-feuille, mini Victoria sponges, strawberry and cream meringue nests and miniature strawberry and rhubarb cheesecakes. Who of the three will take home the trophy?

programme.title: James Martin Delicious

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off

Finally, the cooks attempt to produce a showstopping cake with a hidden design detail, but who will impress the judges, and who will be the first to leave?

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off

programme.title: Ainsley's Taste of the Bahamas
programme.desc: S1 E1 — Flavour Foundations: Bahamian ClassicsChef Ainsley Harriott explores the vibrant flavours, local producers, markets and unique dishes of the island nation located in the Atlantic Ocean. Then he wraps things up in his beachside kitchen with prawn and coconut fritters served with a pickled coconut slaw.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Seventh Round-of-16 MatchCoverage of the seventh round-of-16 match (Kick-off 5.00pm), which takes place at Atlanta Stadium in the USA. The fans in attendance will hope for a more entertaining affair than in the corresponding clash in Al Rayyan four years ago, as Morocco and Spain played out a monotonous 0-0 draw over 120 minutes, in which the Spanish dominated possession but did little with it as few chances were created. The tie came to life in the subsequent penalty shootout as the 2010 champions failed to convert any of their three attempts with goalkeeper Yassine Bounou saving from Sergio Busquets and Carlos Soler after Pablo Sarabia first hit the post, while the Atlas Lions scored three of their four penalties to progress. By missing their three spot kicks, Spain became only the second team to not score in a World Cup penalty shoot-out, following in the footsteps of Switzerland who lost to Ukraine in 2006 by the same 3-0 scoreline.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Eighth Round-of-16 MatchCoverage of the eighth round-of-16 match (Kick-off 9.00pm), which takes place at BC Place Vancouver in Canada. The concluding match of this stage four years ago proved to be memorable for several reasons, not the least the final score, as Portugal claimed a comprehensive 6-1 victory over Switzerland. This despite the fact Cristiano Ronaldo was left out of the starting line-up for the first time in a major tournament since Euro 2008 with Gonçalo Ramos making his first start instead, which proved to be a wise move as Ramos became the youngest to score a World Cup hat-trick since Flórián Albert in 1962. Others to get their name on the scoresheet were Raphaël Guerreiro, Rafael Leão, and experienced centre-back Pepe, who became the oldest player to score in the World Cup knockout stage and the second oldest to score at any stage, behind Cameroon's Roger Milla.

programme.title: The Assembly
programme.desc: S2 E1 — Stephen FryStephen Fry faces a grilling from a cast of autistic and learning-disabled interviewers. Did he take drugs in Buckingham Palace? Is he happy to be alive? As the questions come thick and fast, Stephen opens up about mental health, shame and self-criticism. There are probing questions about love, identity and belief, alongside moments of pure mischief and laughter - including an explosive question about his sexual preferences.

programme.title: Ainsley's Taste of the Bahamas
programme.desc: S1 E1 — Flavour Foundations: Bahamian ClassicsChef Ainsley Harriott explores the vibrant flavours, local producers, markets and unique dishes of the island nation located in the Atlantic Ocean. He kicks off his island adventures with the comfort foods at the heart of Bahamian cooking, from 'chicken in da bag' at Bamboo Shack to learning to put his peas before his rice with chef Tevin Kemp. Then he wraps things up in his beachside kitchen with prawn and coconut fritters served with a pickled coconut slaw.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Seventh Round-of-16 MatchCoverage of the seventh round-of-16 match (Kick-off 5.00pm), which takes place at Atlanta Stadium in the USA. The fans in attendance will hope for a more entertaining affair than in the corresponding clash in Al Rayyan four years ago, as Morocco and Spain played out a monotonous 0-0 draw over 120 minutes, in which the Spanish dominated possession but did little with it as few chances were created. The tie came to life in the subsequent penalty shootout as the 2010 champions failed to convert any of their three attempts with goalkeeper Yassine Bounou saving from Sergio Busquets and Carlos Soler after Pablo Sarabia first hit the post, while the Atlas Lions scored three of their four penalties to progress. By missing their three spot kicks, Spain became only the second team to not score in a World Cup penalty shoot-out, following in the footsteps of Switzerland who lost to Ukraine in 2006 by the same 3-0 scoreline.

programme.title: ITV Evening News; Weather
programme.desc: S11 E134 — 07/07/2026A round-up of the day's news headlines and talking points from the UK and around the world.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Eighth Round-of-16 MatchCoverage of the eighth round-of-16 match (Kick-off 9.00pm), which takes place at BC Place Vancouver in Canada. The concluding match of this stage four years ago proved to be memorable for several reasons, not the least the final score, as Portugal claimed a comprehensive 6-1 victory over Switzerland. This despite the fact Cristiano Ronaldo was left out of the starting line-up for the first time in a major tournament since Euro 2008 with Gonçalo Ramos making his first start instead, which proved to be a wise move as Ramos became the youngest to score a World Cup hat-trick since Flórián Albert in 1962. Others to get their name on the scoresheet were Raphaël Guerreiro, Rafael Leão, and experienced centre-back Pepe, who became the oldest player to score in the World Cup knockout stage and the second oldest to score at any stage, behind Cameroon's Roger Milla.

programme.title: The Assembly
programme.desc: S2 E1 — Stephen FryStephen Fry faces a grilling from a cast of autistic and learning-disabled interviewers. Did he take drugs in Buckingham Palace? Is he happy to be alive? As the questions come thick and fast, Stephen opens up about mental health, shame and self-criticism. There are probing questions about love, identity and belief, alongside moments of pure mischief and laughter - including an explosive question about his sexual preferences.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Seventh Round-of-16 MatchCoverage of the seventh round-of-16 match (Kick-off 5.00pm), which takes place at Atlanta Stadium in the USA. The fans in attendance will hope for a more entertaining affair than in the corresponding clash in Al Rayyan four years ago, as Morocco and Spain played out a monotonous 0-0 draw over 120 minutes, in which the Spanish dominated possession but did little with it as few chances were created. The tie came to life in the subsequent penalty shootout as the 2010 champions failed to convert any of their three attempts with goalkeeper Yassine Bounou saving from Sergio Busquets and Carlos Soler after Pablo Sarabia first hit the post, while the Atlas Lions scored three of their four penalties to progress. By missing their three spot kicks, Spain became only the second team to not score in a World Cup penalty shoot-out, following in the footsteps of Switzerland who lost to Ukraine in 2006 by the same 3-0 scoreline.

programme.desc: S11 E134 — 07/07/2026A round-up of the day's news headlines and talking points from the UK and around the world.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Eighth Round-of-16 MatchCoverage of the eighth round-of-16 match (Kick-off 9.00pm), which takes place at BC Place Vancouver in Canada. The concluding match of this stage four years ago proved to be memorable for several reasons, not the least the final score, as Portugal claimed a comprehensive 6-1 victory over Switzerland. This despite the fact Cristiano Ronaldo was left out of the starting line-up for the first time in a major tournament since Euro 2008 with Gonçalo Ramos making his first start instead, which proved to be a wise move as Ramos became the youngest to score a World Cup hat-trick since Flórián Albert in 1962. Others to get their name on the scoresheet were Raphaël Guerreiro, Rafael Leão, and experienced centre-back Pepe, who became the oldest player to score in the World Cup knockout stage and the second oldest to score at any stage, behind Cameroon's Roger Milla.

programme.title: The Assembly
programme.desc: S2 E1 — Stephen FryStephen Fry faces a grilling from a cast of autistic and learning-disabled interviewers. Did he take drugs in Buckingham Palace? Is he happy to be alive? As the questions come thick and fast, Stephen opens up about mental health, shame and self-criticism. There are probing questions about love, identity and belief, alongside moments of pure mischief and laughter - including an explosive question about his sexual preferences.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Seventh Round-of-16 MatchCoverage of the seventh round-of-16 match (Kick-off 5.00pm), which takes place at Atlanta Stadium in the USA. The fans in attendance will hope for a more entertaining affair than in the corresponding clash in Al Rayyan four years ago, as Morocco and Spain played out a monotonous 0-0 draw over 120 minutes, in which the Spanish dominated possession but did little with it as few chances were created. The tie came to life in the subsequent penalty shootout as the 2010 champions failed to convert any of their three attempts with goalkeeper Yassine Bounou saving from Sergio Busquets and Carlos Soler after Pablo Sarabia first hit the post, while the Atlas Lions scored three of their four penalties to progress. By missing their three spot kicks, Spain became only the second team to not score in a World Cup penalty shoot-out, following in the footsteps of Switzerland who lost to Ukraine in 2006 by the same 3-0 scoreline.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Eighth Round-of-16 MatchCoverage of the eighth round-of-16 match (Kick-off 9.00pm), which takes place at BC Place Vancouver in Canada. The concluding match of this stage four years ago proved to be memorable for several reasons, not the least the final score, as Portugal claimed a comprehensive 6-1 victory over Switzerland. This despite the fact Cristiano Ronaldo was left out of the starting line-up for the first time in a major tournament since Euro 2008 with Gonçalo Ramos making his first start instead, which proved to be a wise move as Ramos became the youngest to score a World Cup hat-trick since Flórián Albert in 1962. Others to get their name on the scoresheet were Raphaël Guerreiro, Rafael Leão, and experienced centre-back Pepe, who became the oldest player to score in the World Cup knockout stage and the second oldest to score at any stage, behind Cameroon's Roger Milla.

programme.title: The Assembly
programme.desc: S2 E1 — Stephen FryStephen Fry faces a grilling from a cast of autistic and learning-disabled interviewers. Did he take drugs in Buckingham Palace? Is he happy to be alive? As the questions come thick and fast, Stephen opens up about mental health, shame and self-criticism. There are probing questions about love, identity and belief, alongside moments of pure mischief and laughter - including an explosive question about his sexual preferences.

programme.desc: Eighth Round-of-16 MatchCoverage of the eighth round-of-16 match (Kick-off 9.00pm), which takes place at BC Place Vancouver in Canada. The concluding match of this stage four years ago proved to be memorable for several reasons, not the least the final score, as Portugal claimed a comprehensive 6-1 victory over Switzerland. This despite the fact Cristiano Ronaldo was left out of the starting line-up for the first time in a major tournament since Euro 2008 with Gonçalo Ramos making his first start instead, which proved to be a wise move as Ramos became the youngest to score a World Cup hat-trick since Flórián Albert in 1962. Others to get their name on the scoresheet were Raphaël Guerreiro, Rafael Leão, and experienced centre-back Pepe, who became the oldest player to score in the World Cup knockout stage and the second oldest to score at any stage, behind Cameroon's Roger Milla.

programme.title: The Assembly
programme.desc: S2 E1 — Stephen FryStephen Fry faces a grilling from a cast of autistic and learning-disabled interviewers. Did he take drugs in Buckingham Palace? Is he happy to be alive? As the questions come thick and fast, Stephen opens up about mental health, shame and self-criticism. There are probing questions about love, identity and belief, alongside moments of pure mischief and laughter - including an explosive question about his sexual preferences.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Seventh Round-of-16 MatchCoverage of the seventh round-of-16 match (Kick-off 5.00pm), which takes place at Atlanta Stadium in the USA. The fans in attendance will hope for a more entertaining affair than in the corresponding clash in Al Rayyan four years ago, as Morocco and Spain played out a monotonous 0-0 draw over 120 minutes, in which the Spanish dominated possession but did little with it as few chances were created. The tie came to life in the subsequent penalty shootout as the 2010 champions failed to convert any of their three attempts with goalkeeper Yassine Bounou saving from Sergio Busquets and Carlos Soler after Pablo Sarabia first hit the post, while the Atlas Lions scored three of their four penalties to progress. By missing their three spot kicks, Spain became only the second team to not score in a World Cup penalty shoot-out, following in the footsteps of Switzerland who lost to Ukraine in 2006 by the same 3-0 scoreline.

The tie came to life in the subsequent penalty shootout as the 2010 champions failed to convert any of their three attempts with goalkeeper Yassine Bounou saving from Sergio Busquets and Carlos Soler after Pablo Sarabia first hit the post, while the Atlas Lions scored three of their four penalties to progress. By missing their three spot kicks, Spain became only the second team to not score in a World Cup penalty shoot-out, following in the footsteps of Switzerland who lost to Ukraine in 2006 by the same 3-0 scoreline.

programme.title: ITV Evening News; Weather
programme.desc: S11 E134 — 07/07/2026A round-up of the day's news headlines and talking points from the UK and around the world.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Eighth Round-of-16 MatchCoverage of the eighth round-of-16 match (Kick-off 9.00pm), which takes place at BC Place Vancouver in Canada. The concluding match of this stage four years ago proved to be memorable for several reasons, not the least the final score, as Portugal claimed a comprehensive 6-1 victory over Switzerland. This despite the fact Cristiano Ronaldo was left out of the starting line-up for the first time in a major tournament since Euro 2008 with Gonçalo Ramos making his first start instead, which proved to be a wise move as Ramos became the youngest to score a World Cup hat-trick since Flórián Albert in 1962. Others to get their name on the scoresheet were Raphaël Guerreiro, Rafael Leão, and experienced centre-back Pepe, who became the oldest player to score in the World Cup knockout stage and the second oldest to score at any stage, behind Cameroon's Roger Milla.

programme.title: The Assembly
programme.desc: S2 E1 — Stephen FryStephen Fry faces a grilling from a cast of autistic and learning-disabled interviewers. Did he take drugs in Buckingham Palace? Is he happy to be alive? As the questions come thick and fast, Stephen opens up about mental health, shame and self-criticism. There are probing questions about love, identity and belief, alongside moments of pure mischief and laughter - including an explosive question about his sexual preferences.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Seventh Round-of-16 MatchCoverage of the seventh round-of-16 match (Kick-off 5.00pm), which takes place at Atlanta Stadium in the USA. The fans in attendance will hope for a more entertaining affair than in the corresponding clash in Al Rayyan four years ago, as Morocco and Spain played out a monotonous 0-0 draw over 120 minutes, in which the Spanish dominated possession but did little with it as few chances were created. The tie came to life in the subsequent penalty shootout as the 2010 champions failed to convert any of their three attempts with goalkeeper Yassine Bounou saving from Sergio Busquets and Carlos Soler after Pablo Sarabia first hit the post, while the Atlas Lions scored three of their four penalties to progress. By missing their three spot kicks, Spain became only the second team to not score in a World Cup penalty shoot-out, following in the footsteps of Switzerland who lost to Ukraine in 2006 by the same 3-0 scoreline.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Eighth Round-of-16 MatchCoverage of the eighth round-of-16 match (Kick-off 9.00pm), which takes place at BC Place Vancouver in Canada. The concluding match of this stage four years ago proved to be memorable for several reasons, not the least the final score, as Portugal claimed a comprehensive 6-1 victory over Switzerland. This despite the fact Cristiano Ronaldo was left out of the starting line-up for the first time in a major tournament since Euro 2008 with Gonçalo Ramos making his first start instead, which proved to be a wise move as Ramos became the youngest to score a World Cup hat-trick since Flórián Albert in 1962. Others to get their name on the scoresheet were Raphaël Guerreiro, Rafael Leão, and experienced centre-back Pepe, who became the oldest player to score in the World Cup knockout stage and the second oldest to score at any stage, behind Cameroon's Roger Milla.

programme.desc: S2 E1 — Stephen FryStephen Fry faces a grilling from a cast of autistic and learning-disabled interviewers. Did he take drugs in Buckingham Palace? Is he happy to be alive? As the questions come thick and fast, Stephen opens up about mental health, shame and self-criticism. There are probing questions about love, identity and belief, alongside moments of pure mischief and laughter - including an explosive question about his sexual preferences.

programme.desc: Garfield takes us through the ages to tell us the history of dogs. As we know, he has a poor opinion of them, but an incident will make him change his mind. After all, all dogs are not useless!

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Garfield is bored. He has nothing to do. Well, not exactly: watching Odie and the squirrels in the garden, there's fun ahead after all!

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Eddie Gourmand has built a super attraction park, made completely out of cheese. Squeak and his friends beg Garfield to take them there but with Harry working as a security guard, it won't be easy!

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Pooky has disappeared again, but this time, it's Nermal who finds it. He is willing to give it back to him at one condition: Garfield has to be really nice to Nermal for the rest of the day!

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Garfield's cat instincts push him to climb on a tree. But how will he get down? Everyone tries to give him a hand, but they end up stuck in that tree! Now he's out on a limb; who will save him?

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Nermal doesn't believe in super heroes. Garfield does and he tries desperately to convince him. Even if that means disguising himself as Ultra Powerful Guy.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Garfield receives a strange helmet which lets him read everyone's thoughts. He even catches aliens' conversations who are just about to conquer Earth! Garfield has to stop this plot immediately!

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: After Odie dreams of being a super hero, Garfield mocks him for it. But when Garfield really gets into trouble, Odie puts his grudges aside and flies off to help him. And this time he REALLY flies!

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Nermal makes a bet with Garfield: if Garfield manages not to eat for a whole hour, he won't see Nermal for a whole month. Will Garfield be victorious ?

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: A caveman has been found in a block of ice. When Garfield accidentally thaws him, he falls in love with Olga. But if there's no caveman in the new exhibit, the museum will be ruined!

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: There's a new employee at the pound: it's a robot with all the latest gadgets and it's job to make all the pets stick to the straight and narrow!

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Tis the holiday season for Garfield and the whole gang. Jon has invited not only his parents and Doc Boy, but Liz's family as well, and so Garfield must be on his best behaviour.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Jon's Christmas plans take a turn for the unexpected, prompting Garfield to learn that there's more to Christmas than opening presents and eating!

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: How can Garfield make the cutest cat in the country look ugly? It won't be easy but our orange friend is VERY motivated...

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Ah! A pizza dinner in a countryside cottage, doesn't that sound nice? Yep, except when the house is haunted.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: How can Garfield get rid of Aunt Ivy, who hates animals? Garfield has an idea.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: When the owner of an outer space fast food chain plans to turn all the inhabitants of Earth into chickens, Garfield becomes our unlikely hero.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: A retelling of the history of the cat throughout time, as told by Garfield. But is it really a retelling of history, or a rewriting?

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Garfield, from now on, you're on a diet! Don't argue, it's for your own good!

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Gravity-free cooking, have you ever heard of such a thing? According to Garfield, it's delicious...

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Yahooooo! Jon has won the lottery!!! But... but where is his ticket?

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Bad news: Jon's nieces are coming over! The ones who love to dress Garfield up? You got it.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Jon has become allergic to Garfield. But what if the only solution is to get rid of him?

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Garfield has always said he would go to the ends of the earth to eat lasagna. And that's exactly what he's going to do!

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: In your opinion, who should you call to rid a house of mice? An exterminator, or Garfield?

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Odie is accidentally sold to Mr. Allwork, an awful lawyer who wants to sue Jon, and Garfield must find a way to get him back or never be fed again!

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Jon, Odie and especially Garfield have to put up with an unexpected houseguest with big demands and an even bigger appetite.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: It would be fantastic to get tomorrow's newspaper today, wouldn't it? Jon could play all the winning numbers in the lottery and then Garfield could eat tons of pizza, unless...

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: So Garfield's been working the fields like nobody else? Has he been hypnotised or what?! Well... anything's possible...

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: What starts out as a romantic night at Vito's for Jon and Liz could end up in a marriage with children, all thanks to Garfield stomach.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Garfield will stop at nothing to get his hands on Chef Squisito's lasagna, which his wistful student claims is the 'best lasagna in the world.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Garfield is the unwilling guinea pig for his young neighbour's newest invention: a size altering ray.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: When Nermal's revenge on Garfield goes wrong, Garfield finds himself roaming the streets with no memory of who he is.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Garfield has to survive a day filled with nothing but bad luck after crossing paths with Jonah, a sad black cat.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Odie and the people he has licked are somehow making everyone act like dogs: it's a canine contagion! No one will be spared without the help of Garfield, who for some reason is immune.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Garfield must save a lost baby bluebird from finding a new home: Harry's stomach!

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: What's eating Eddie Gourmand? That's what Garfield is about to find out thanks to a new invention that allows him to get inside his brain.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: When Jon, Odie and Garfield are duped by items they've bought on the All-Buying-Stuff Channel, Garfield discovers it's going to take more than a polite request to get their money back.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Jon's new super computer program, Millie, has taken over all the appliances in the house and will not stop until it has taken over the world!

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: An emergency fumigation prompts Aunt Ivy to impose herself on Jon, Odie and Garfield, leaving Jon with the responsibility of yet another cumbersome character.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: What if every person in the world were just waiting for their call to be taken, their life always on hold? Garfield is about to find out.

programme.title: The Garfield Show

programme.title: The Garfield Show

programme.title: The Garfield Show

programme.title: The Garfield Show

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: When Jon unleashes a trickster genie in a bottle, he gets the tables turned on him and must grant the genie his three wishes lest he be turned into a frog.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Shrimpy the Elephant is being mistreated by Dr. Whipple. When he escapes, it's up to Garfield to help him stay hidden.

programme.title: The Garfield Show

programme.title: The Garfield Show

programme.title: The Garfield Show

programme.title: The Garfield Show

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Bruno, an alley cat, is sick and tired of watching Garfield get waited on hand and foot while he has to live in a trash can. And so he decides to make Garfield's home his own.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Could this be the end of Vito's Pizzeria? Garfield must save the two loves of Vito's life from the hands of Brent Mogul, real estate tycoon.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Dr. Goodiegoodie, an old TV show Jon used to watch, is no ordinary show. It's the show that watches you. When Dr. Goodiegoodie sees Garfield being mean to Nermal, he decides to punish him...

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Paddy the Leprechaun has brought the rain with him and ruined Jon and Liz's trip to the beach. Garfield and Odie think they're saved from the clutches of Aunt Ivy.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Squeak has the power to see the future. How you may ask? Garfield doesn't care so long as he can make big bucks off of it. But when's Squeak's new power suddenly runs out, it's Jon on the line!

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Garfield is preparing for hibernation. But sleeping for months when you live with others isn't so easy after all, especially when they can get you into trouble without you even knowing!

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Garfield and Odie show the pampered and spoiled, but lonely Prince Orloff what fun and playing is all about. Or at least Odie does, while Garfield watches.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: When a mole's tunnel collapses Jon's yard, affecting Garfield's friends, the strays, and squirrels, Garfield comes up with a master plan that just might solve everyone's problems.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Jon is birdsitting his editor's parrot, Paxton, while Odie is away. But soon Paxton's doom and gloom attitude is bringing everyone down. Not even Garfield can help him but maybe someone else can...

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: There's something very strange going on with the weather in town when it starts to rain sandwiches after a massive heatwave.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Jon, Odie, Garfield, and the twin follow what seems to be the source of the bizarre weather: a single cloud. It leads them to something and someone they could never have imagined.

programme.title: The Garfield Show

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Squeak and his mice family have taken up residence in Garfield's house, to Jon's despair, who will deprive Garfield of lasagnas if he doesn't turn things back to normal.

programme.desc: Garfield's favourite restaurant, Vito's Pizzeria, is in jeopardy. The evil Mama Meany wants to buy it to expand his own restaurant, with the PizzaGrand 7000 capable of making ten pizzas a minute.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: A mother bluebird is locked in a neighbourhood garage, so who will care for her eggs? That's a job for Garfield, who is sometimes quite a mother hen.

programme.title: The Garfield Show

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Odie falls in love with a brush. Garfield becomes a little bit jealous about that and decides to make the brush disappear.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Jon finds an old accordion. It's unbearable for Garfield who totally dislikes this music. He will do everything to get rid of it.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Jon has won a live turkey in a raffle and wants to prepare it for dinner, but he can't make up his mind to eat it. Neither can Garfield!

programme.title: The Garfield Show

programme.title: The Garfield Show

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Who has stolen Pooky? After a night drying on the clothes line, Pooky has disappeared, and Garfield can't sleep without him.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: It's night-time and the full moon and the alignment of the planets are having a strange effect on Odie.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Liz's parents are coming over to meet Jon and Jon really has to make a good impression.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Jon goes to visit his brother, Doc Boy, who lives on a livestock farm. It's out in the country, and since Garfield is a real city cat, it's no picnic for him!

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: There is a Pet Show in town, and the winner will get a huge lasagna from Vito's restaurant. That's worth trying for Garfield. But Nermal is in the competition too...

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: There's a new TV Show called Instant Petmatching, which is about seeing if pets are matching with their owner. The result of the test is that Jon and Garfield are incompatible!

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Odie finds the pot of gold at the bottom of a rainbow. The owner, a leprechaun, will grant all the wishes Garfield can think of.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Odie has found a strange, big bone in the garden. After some research, Garfield has found that it might be a dinosaur bone, and that could make him rich... enough for having lasagna forever, at least!

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: A salesman has sold Jon a cleaning Robot, which is very annoying to his two pets.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Garfield is really unhappy because he has to be on diet. And he's having nightmares about it.

programme.title: The Garfield Show

programme.title: The Garfield Show

programme.desc: Garfield is stuck in a parallel world where cats have taken the place of humans, and vice versa!

programme.desc: Jon sends Garfield to Dr Whipple's Show in order for him to learn how to be a well-behaved cat.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Garfield accidentally climbs into an outer space traveller's car, which sends him into parallel worlds.

programme.title: The Garfield Show

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Our heroes are on a fishing trip. Odie saves a little fish and goes to explore the underwater world with Garfield.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Liz asks Jon to look after her goldfish while she's out of town. When Garfield finds this out, all he can think about is the great fry-up he's going to have.

programme.title: Heartland Homicide
programme.desc: Victoria survives a horrific crash, wins a large settlement and then dies after an explosion.

programme.title: Heartland Homicide
programme.desc: Nicholas Brophy is excited to start his senior year of high school, but after going out to visit a friend, he never returns. The case evolves as investigators connect the night of Nicholas's disappearance to gang activity in the area.

programme.title: Heartland Homicide
programme.desc: Former pro-wrestler Ivan Radocaj, known as the Croatian Giant, is ambushed and brutally murdered in the tiny Manitoba hamlet of Inwood. It looks like a robbery gone wrong, but what investigators hear over a wire tap brings a monstrous plot to light.

programme.title: The Unperfect Crime
programme.desc: Documentary exploring the 1997 Loomis-Fargo armoured car heist in North Carolina and the serio-comic fates of its underdog perpetrators. who fell victim to avarice, mutual betrayals and false romantic promises.

programme.title: The Krays: The Myth Behind the Legend
programme.desc: Rivals and other contemporaries discuss gangsters Ronnie and Reggie Kray, who ran London's East End.

programme.title: Mafia's Greatest Hits
programme.sub-title: Tony Spilotro - The Las Vegas Enforcer
programme.desc: Enforcer Tony `The Ant' Spilotro left dozens of bodies in his wake as he protected the Chicago Outfit's interests in Vegas casinos. Soon he became a target of the FBI and the Mob.

programme.title: Mafia's Greatest Hits
programme.desc: Tales of real-life crime told by the FBI. Vito Genovese dealt with disloyalty ruthlessly and rose through the Mafia ranks, but he was to cause his own downfall with a massive error.

programme.title: Mafia's Greatest Hits
programme.desc: Carmine Galante took the Mob into the world of heroin and even when locked up in jail, Galente still managed to control the streets and profit from his drug empire.

programme.title: Mafia's Greatest Hits
programme.desc: Ex-FBI agent Joe Pistone, who infiltrated the Mafia for six years as mobster `Donnie Brasco', reveals how his undercover work led to over 100 convictions.

programme.title: Mafia's Greatest Hits
programme.desc: Financier Allen Dorfman used union pension funds to bankroll the Mafia and the FBI quickly realised they could bankrupt the Mob by pursuing Dorfman.

programme.title: When Fred Met Rose
programme.desc: Documentary series examining what led Fred and Rose West to become serial killers.

programme.title: Fred and Rose: The West Murders
programme.desc: Focuses on the notorious house which the couple shared in Gloucester. Fred and Rose murdered their first three victims - Anna McFall, Charmaine West and then Rena Costello - because they `got in the way'. But when they moved into 25 Cromwell Street, the couple began to kill for sexual thrills.

programme.title: Fred and Rose: The West Murders
programme.desc: Looks at how a dogged police officer, Hazel Savage, fought to have the Wests' patio excavated when she became suspicious about the whereabouts of their daughter. The film also includes insights from both Fred and Rose West's former solicitors.

programme.title: Great Crimes and Trials
programme.desc: Seemingly normal couple Karla Hornolka and Paul Bernardo murdered two teenage girls together, but would their dedication to one another last through the trial?

programme.title: Couples Who Kill
programme.desc: Two mentally unhinged ex-military men team up for a deadly crime spree as their obsession with living life on the edge grows out of control.

programme.title: Couples Who Kill
